# Version 4.151.0
> **Skia m151 stable release** · Released July 30, 2026 · [NuGet](https://www.nuget.org/packages/SkiaSharp/4.151.0) · [GitHub Release](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/releases/tag/v4.151.0)

> **API changes** · [SkiaSharp API diff](4.151.0/index.md) · [HarfBuzzSharp API diff](harfbuzzsharp/14.2.1/index.md)

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.151.0 updates to Skia m151 and removes avoidable allocations across color, shaping, and text APIs. The release improves WebAssembly exception handling, fixes an encoded-image resource leak, and delivers lower-allocation HarfBuzzSharp and SKShaper paths.

## Breaking Changes

*None in this release.*

## Engine

- **Updated to Skia m151** — Moves the bundled renderer to Chrome milestone 151 and incorporates subsequent upstream stability fixes. ([#4294](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4294), [#4312](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4312), [#4382](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4382), [#4443](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4443), [#4489](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4489))

## API Surface

- **Span-based color parsing added** — SKColor hex parsing gains ReadOnlySpan<char> overloads for allocation-conscious callers. ([#4345](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4345))

## Bug Fixes

- **Encoded-image native resource leak fixed** — Creating an image from encoded data with a subset rectangle no longer leaks its native resource. ([#3997](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3997))

## Lifecycle & Internals

- **Color and text hot paths reduce allocations** — Ports color conversion and premultiplication work to managed code, removes tag parsing allocations, and exposes shaped glyph results through zero-copy spans. ([#4370](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4370), [#4385](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4385), [#4396](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4396), [#4388](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4388))

## Platform

- **WebAssembly exception handling updated** — Adds Emscripten 5.0.6 static libraries and support for the current .NET WebAssembly exception model. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#4428](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4428), [#4459](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4459), [#4487](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4487))

## HarfBuzzSharp 14.2.1

HarfBuzzSharp eliminates UTF-8 input and tag parsing allocations and improves access to shaped glyph results.
